body_text:
I wander through the woods: not up the mountains -those are STEEP!!- but some more easily walkable pathes. I think I am getting fitter. When I come to the crossing of two trails I step into the weirdest sight I have ever seen: the elderman is naked, smeared in coloured mud -and cutting the throat of someone! Some guys in hooded robes turn towards me when I stumble back and break a branch with a noise much louder than the gurgling of the dying man. I turn and run before they react. Was that a pentagram on the forrest floor?
I run like a hare ...well: like an IT hare with short breath but unlimted panic. I run without stopping until I reach the shed of the village snowplow (that is not deligated to horsepower). I break down there and try to both hide and breathe with middling rather than fair results. While I am still way to winded to run any more. Kate the buxom gal hurry-scurries to me and whispes: "Did you see them doing their thing? I did, too: then I ran as fast as I could. Not fast enough, that is for sure. Not that you can run any faster: and what good would it do, here in the mountains?" She sighs: "I got away because they didn't realize I am the witness to their crime. I am disguised so well thanks to the friendly neighbourhood pharma con that no on will ever recognize me. You see: I used to be a guy. Just like you. Then I witnessed something that will get me killed if they ever learn that I know it. So I run, a little faster and further than you. But this is not about bragging: I broke down, winded and unable to run any further, at the backyard of that research compound where no one ever is let in. When I could move again -cramps REALLY hurt, by the way: you will see what I mean quite soon- I was hungry like a wolf. So I checked their garbage: pharma cons throw away food trays that were in the cafe even if they are still unopened: hygene plus. And there were such food trays. A racoon had prepared the way by getting fried on the fence, so I got in without problems, grabbed a chicken breast sandwich and a milkshake and ran again. I ate, and hid here: they keep blankets here for the snowplow crew. Then I slept a couple of days or so, and woke up with no dick but the tits that you stare at all the time. I have been a woman since, and I hate it. But while they do not let go, neither do they kill me: that is a win in my book." She pats me on the head: "So I guess you have the same option that I had: eat some of the good stuff, and get a change over: or get killed for seeing the quaint local customs in action." She grimaced: "Now please excuse me: that changeover is complete, and I am getting my period AGAIN. That shit is really bad for you, man. Be good, I have to run."
She leaves with great haste, looking a little green around the gill, so to speak.
